# Jan Henrik Gundelsby

> Head of Knowit Research at Knowit (Oslo) and part-time Lecturer (Universitetslektor) in Software Engineering at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo. Researches how organizations adopt AI agents in software development: human-AI collaboration, agentic software engineering, technical and cognitive debt, and large-scale agile. Researcher in KAIROS, a Knowit-led research project on human-AI collaboration with SINTEF and industry partners. ORCID 0000-0001-5275-6553.

## Key Facts
- **Current roles:** Head of Knowit Research (2020–present) · Lecturer (Universitetslektor) in Software Engineering, University of Oslo (2026–present)
- **Previous roles:** Service Platform Lead at Oslo Origo / Oslo municipality (2020) · CTO and Principal Engineer at Knowit Objectnet (2018–2020)
- **Education:** Cand.scient. (M.Sc.) in Computer Science, University of Oslo
- **Research & specialties:** Agentic software engineering, AI coding agents, human-AI collaboration, technical and cognitive debt, platform engineering, DevOps, large-scale agile
